sections.chapter_title: Ethernet (ETH): media access control (MAC) with DMA controller
sections.text_helper: Section 48.2 "Ethernet main features" in chapter 48 (Ethernet (ETH): media access control (MAC) with DMA controller), RM0522 Rev 1, page 2133.
sections.section_content:
The Ethernet peripheral embeds a dedicated DMA for direct memory interface, a media
access controller (MAC) and a PHY interface block supporting several formats.
